objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky pastry characterized by its distinct crescent shape and laminated dough structure.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The surface presents a golden-brown hue resulting from baking, often with slight variations in shading across the layers.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item appears as a baked food product, lacking any biological features such as fur, skin, or limbs associated with living organisms.

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.
